notes: Corrected: the supplied the (t010) moves from the preposition to the nominal expression. MACULA gives s003 the tag R with no article token of any kind, so no article morpheme is present, rule 30's fusion has nothing to fuse, and rule 15 assigns the supplied the to the noun it determines.

The chapter's other pointed prepositions before a definite noun (13.5 s003/s004, s014/s015; 13.15 s006/s007, s010/s011) do carry bracketed [הַ] tokens, which take the written the under rule 12; this verse is the case where none is supplied.
The ASV reorders the whole verse; units are matched by morpheme, not by position.
